title: LADA R vs T.B.D., Sep 21
notes: LADA R's first processed game. Home game at Renton: we wore white (blue numbers) on the right (home) bench; T.B.D. wore dark green, a few of them navy or royal blue. The video came as 3246x1440 and was scaled up to Renton's usual 3840x1702 for the pipeline.

Periods from the arena scoreboard: 0:12-18:12, 19:52-39:29 and 41:14-75:41 of the video. The clock ran through stoppages in the 1st and 2nd and stopped at whistles in the 3rd; the video reaches the final horn. Our goalie was at the right net in the 1st and 3rd, the left in the 2nd.

Goals from SportNinja's game sheet, placed in the video by the scoreboard and checked by eye: T.B.D. at 2:01, 5:43 and 6:42 (all #0 Nanakul, 1st), ours at 9:57 (clock 8:10, 1st, Vorobyov #39 from Rabotyagov #79), T.B.D. at 29:55 (#26 Loch) and 38:52 (#26 Loch, clock 0:08, 2nd), ours at 41:43 (17:26, 3rd, Moshchuk #57 from Vorobyov #39) and 62:50 (6:30, 3rd, Shachak #92 from Shtin #64), T.B.D. at 72:39 (#43 Grudzien, 1:29, 3rd). The sheet puts Moshchuk's goal at 17:26 of the 2nd, but nothing happened then; 34 s into the 3rd the board's clock stopped at 17:26 and the home score went from 1 to 2, so it is in the 3rd here.
Shots on goal from the game sheet: LADA R 22, T.B.D. 39 (8-12, 6-13, 8-14 by period). The board's shot count fell behind in the 3rd (about 20-29 at the end) and could not be read automatically.

Penalties: Soubochev #9 high-sticking in the 2nd (21:06 of the video; the board ran 3 minutes); Dotsenko #81 tripping in the 2nd (32:45; 3 minutes, the first part 4-on-4); Shtin #64 interference in the 3rd (49:44), coincidental with their #71, so 4-on-4; Dotsenko #81 boarding plus a 10-minute misconduct in the 3rd (54:32): Bogdanov #10 served the minor and Dotsenko did not play again. Vorobyov #39's slashing on the sheet was never served: no panel lit, the box stayed empty and he kept playing. T.B.D. #0's tripping was not served either.

Perry #99 (a sub) played goal, so he has no skater time. Absent: Belousenko #11, Sergeev #12, Shikhanov #70, Shanygin #72 and Fateev #80. Rabotyagov #79 played all game though his number was rarely readable.

About 16 lineup stretches were checked by eye and fixed with on/off entries, among them Shachak #92 on the ice for his own goal (the solver had Rabotyagov). Four short stretches in the 3rd really had 4 of us on without a penalty, one of them an injury stoppage with Vorobyov #39 down while Shtin #64 went off unreplaced.
